name: Four-point current measurement selector
aliases: Four-point current measurement selector IEC reference
summary: This representation identifies selection among four current-measurement points.
description: This representation identifies selection among four current-measurement points. The additional measurement point expands the selected current-input circuits while retaining a common meter. Each position therefore needs an unambiguous circuit identity.
Provide all four measurement references and the actual terminal scheme. A voltage selector with the same number of positions is not an interchangeable current-measurement switch.
readingNotes: Provide the complete selected switch connection and measurement-point table.
The additional point is a circuit interface difference, not merely another drawing orientation.
